name: Chance Encounter
source: Max is young adventurer heading out to conquer dungeons, get loot and do stuff. Along his adventures he will find friends, foes and a whole lot of weird magical crap that makes his days more interesting.
translation: 麦克斯是一名年轻的冒险者，动身外出征服地下城、搜刮战利品、闯荡四方。在旅途中，他将结识挚友、遭遇强敌，并撞见一大堆让他每一天都妙趣横生的古怪魔法玩意儿。
